description: Plan moving a service/controller/policy/middleware, or a content-type with its whole resource (service, controller, routes; relation targets repointed), to another namespace: every call-site rewritten, the files relocated. Refused whole if unsafe. Writes nothing: review, then `apply_edits`.

configSync.description: With config-sync: also update the config/sync files this refactor concerns (roles' permissions, content-manager views). Default: the user's setting, true unless turned off. false when config/sync isn't yours to change here. The warnings say which files.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

ref.description: An artifact ref (plugin::src.helper) or a content-type UID.

name: plan_move
title: Plan moving an artifact or content-type to another namespace (dry-run)
